# Jane Andrews

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v3 c8 P1](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is described as neat, plain, and plump, with a fat paw. She is placid and pink-cheeked.

_Sources: [v2 c6 P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 c26 P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Personality

Jane is a steady, sensible, and practical girl who lacks a lively imagination. She is calm, conscientious, and composed under pressure, though she can worry when her future is at stake. Placid, amiable, and polite, she avoids saying anything that might hurt others' feelings.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P0](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0000), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## History

Jane grew up in Avonlea and attended school with Anne Shirley and their circle of friends. She joined the Queen's class organized by Miss Stacy, successfully passed the Entrance examinations, and attended Queen's Academy, where she excelled in the domestic science course and earned her teaching license. Upon graduating, she accepted a teaching post in Newbridge, where she maintained order strictly and earned a place on the Inspector's Roll of Honor. She actively participated in local village efforts, such as serving as a committee member for the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. After teaching at Newbridge, she was hired to teach at the Avonlea school before accepting a position on the western prairies. During a winter break from Redmond College, she proposed to Anne on behalf of her shy brother Billy, though Anne declined. Later, Jane returned home from the West and married Edward Inglis, a wealthy English millionaire. Following her marriage, she went on a wedding tour to Europe before settling into a prosperous home in Winnipeg, remaining warm and friendly toward her old Avonlea companions.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 c26 P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

- Grew up in Avonlea as a member of the Andrews family  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018), [v3 c41 P6](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0006)</sub>
